notes: Reused typescript headed “Algèbres étales et le différente (4)” and “Tribu n° 65”, pencil folio 51. It records an outline on the different: Filting ideals, the Kähler different, transitivity, comparison with the trace, and tame ramification/Kummer descriptions. There is no H witness for this sheet. The source spells Filting throughout and gives le différente in the heading; both are retained. The presentation explicitly uses A^p and A^q, while the surrounding text calls ΩA(B) a B-module; those letters are left as typed. The quoted lemma ends with homogènes, which is retained. The long parenthesis opened at “il s’agit” has no closing parenthesis on the sheet. The note above p. f. consists of an exclamation mark and a separate short horizontal stroke, both now represented. None of the outline’s mathematical assertions or its referenced results was independently checked; no external source was consulted.
